verdict.rationale: Lambda's own docs describe only a REST API and cloud-init for programmatic instance management, with no first-party natural-language or agentic command interface (docs.lambda.ai/llms.txt and openapi probes 404). A community-built unofficial CLI/MCP server lets AI agents issue natural-language commands like 'launch an H100, ssh in, run a job,' showing the capability is possible but not delivered by the vendor itself. missing for 10: official first-party NL/agent interface, first-party MCP server, documented natural-language command examples in Lambda's own docs.
